fields.reason: Use Shopify to manage publications. Variant publication writes are not enabled.

fields.label: Online store schedule
fields.reason: Publication scheduling is not connected to this editor. Manage it in Shopify.

fields.label: Publish date
fields.reason: Publication scheduling requires the store timezone and publication identity. Manage it in Shopify.

fields.label: Unit price
fields.reason: Unit-price measurement editing is not connected. Its existing value is preserved.

fields.label: Cost per item
fields.reason: Inventory-item cost uses its own permission and currency context. Manage it in Shopify.

fields.label: Barcodes
fields.reason: This connector uses Shopify API 2026-07. Multiple typed barcodes require 2026-10. Manage barcodes in Shopify; secondary entries are never replaced here.

fields.label: Inventory quantity
fields.reason: Choose an inventory location in the stock workspace. Available and on-hand quantities cannot be set independently here.

fields.label: Package
fields.reason: Store package identifiers and the package adapter are not available. Manage the package in Shopify.

fields.label: Weight
fields.reason: Weight units and inventory-item measurement changes are preserved. Manage them in Shopify.

fields.label: Country of origin
fields.reason: The canonical country picker is not connected. Manage origin in Shopify.

fields.label: URL handle (SEO)
fields.reason: Handle changes need a collision check and redirect decision. Manage the URL in Shopify.
